name: print-social-flyer-purple-bmx-photo-diamond-accents
title: Purple BMX flyer with gradient diamond accents
whatItIs: A square flyer for a BMX club on a purple background, combining a gradient-bordered action photo with pink-purple gradient diamond and dotted-line decorative shapes.
whatItMeans: A gradient-outlined photo frame and matching gradient decorative shapes tie a real action photo into an otherwise flat vector-graphic layout.
techniques: outline a photo with a gradient border to bridge photographic and flat vector elements
scatter gradient-filled geometric shapes (diamonds) as texture rather than plain flat color
angle the photo frame slightly for energy appropriate to an action-sport subject

vocabulary.definition: a frame or outline stroke filled with a color gradient rather than a single flat color
